property_summary: For any caller who is the current owner, calling setOwner(newOwner) on the correct contract always updates the public owner to newOwner; the mutant clears owner and returns early so some owner calls leave owner set to address(0) instead of newOwner.
change_summary: Insert clearing owner by setting to address(0) before assigning _owner, causing owner to be address(0) then overwritten (but final value overridden by _owner) — however to ensure behavioral change, insert a revert after clearing to prevent assignment, so final owner differs; here we insert an early return to prevent assignment so owner remains cleared.
